limits: No complete 46-page inspection claimed. Text 41–43 was emitted in a truncated tool result and is not relied on.
Source Theorem 3 is presented within a valid FOA setting. Our finite conditioning theorem is proved for every action without FOA; strict value of extra information is only established in our case.
Theorem 16 uses interior feasible variations. Wage floors and later exit can block the variation; our constrained example is solved directly.
The source gives dynamic context, not our full finite scalar-promise recursion; that recursion is independently proved under explicit no-saving and no-persistent-state hypotheses.
Continuous FOA sufficiency, asymptotic first best, memory under stronger general assumptions and renegotiation theorems are not imported as chapter results.
